anchor.semantic_hook: Being taken by assault is staged as each popular destination becoming a fortress target that eager visitors physically storm.

Shopping carts, beach gear, keyboards, transit shelters, pastry trays, and ski racks distinguish the six stations. A colossal battering ram passes through the wall and can pivot toward every station; this building-sized ram is the concourse's sole impossible feature.
